perfilTexto: I'm Thales Alves Boardman, a Junior Web Developer with hands-on experience in the public sector, working on the development and maintenance of institutional websites using WordPress and Drupal. I have contributed to the creation of internal forms, landing pages, news collection automation for the City Hall, email collection and classification systems, standardized email signatures, testing of the Femictec website, and the new municipal intranet.
perfilTexto2: I also have experience with CodeIgniter 4, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, Python, and basic image editing. I am committed to delivering functional, organized, responsive, and accessible solutions while continuously improving my technical skills. I am currently seeking an opportunity to join a technology team, contribute with my knowledge, and continue growing as a Web Developer.
